Second operand is taken from postgresql.tup_returned for Datadog rows_returned; that pairing is plausible, but the first operand is wrong, so the formula computes a different ratio.
Aggregation differs: Datadog sums raw counter series, while the candidate wraps each counter in rate(...[$__rate_interval]) before summing.

Series selection differs: the Datadog query filters on $host (tag prefix host), which should become host_name=~"$host" given the observed label host_name. The candidate has no host matcher, so it covers a different set of series.
$scope has no prefix and default '*', so dropping it is correct.

No metric mapping for rows_fetched is shown in the definitions; the candidate should use an OTel metric measuring fetched tuples (e.g. postgresql.tup_fetched) if one exists in the dataset, otherwise block with MISSING_METRIC_MAPPING.
